interpretation.allocation_bytes: completed/requested backend allocator bytes in instrumented domains; excludes allocator overhead and RSS
interpretation.allocation_origin: owner/thread from allocation observation; deallocation scope may differ
interpretation.coverage: scoped diagnostic observations only; source identity and case-specific expected counts audited separately
interpretation.event_owner: event field identity: registry C++ owner versus arena base/causal owner for other events; 0 is unscoped
interpretation.generic_sums: bytes/value units are event-specific; sums are grouped by kind and must not be combined across kinds
interpretation.nonshared_domains: domains 1/5 only; shared metadata domains 2/3/4 are excluded; raw owner identity is not a lifetime generation
interpretation.peak_order: global event observation order; not physical allocator-internal simultaneity
interpretation.registry_generations: generation is register event sequence; owner intervals begin inclusive and end at rebind/erase observation; null end means still active at collection
interpretation.shared_metadata: domain 2 shared registry, domain 3 shared pool cached slots, domain 4 shared pool state/control block; owner attribution is causal
interpretation.shared_registry: domain 2 is shared registry storage; retained buckets and other live allocations are reported at trace end
interpretation.single_origin_owner_peak: maximum nonzero raw origin-owner identity bucket peak; excludes owner 0 and may merge reused arena generations; domains 2/3/4 are causal attribution, not exclusive ownership
